description: Save a VERSION of a project, like the editor's Save version (Ctrl+S): a named, frozen copy of the project as it is now (a release that does NOT go live). Nothing needs saving to be kept — every change is kept as it is made — so make a version only when the user asks for one (or at a milestone you tell them about). `name` is the version's name ("before the physics rework"). Nothing changed since the newest version: that version stands, no new one is made. r3_release_list lists the versions; r3_publish_live makes the project live. No editor is needed.

name.description: The version's name, a few words (up to 500 characters).

name: r3_editor_save
